item: Climate: NSIDC Sea Ice Index daily extent parser and consented fetch (A1-5, fixtures only)
key_paths: src/stats/nsidc.py; src/stats/fetch.py; tests/test_nsidc_parser.py; configs/external_artifacts.yml; docs/SECURITY.md; src/static/net-hosts.js
summary: Pure parser for the NSIDC Sea Ice Index v3 daily extent CSV (N and S hemisphere; extent in 10^6 km2 with the 15% concentration definition stated; -9999 is a gap; the every-other-day 1978-1987 record is not interpolated; each partly observed day named in coverage_gaps; the column-names and units rows checked whole; refusals counted; vintages caller-stamped), fetch_nsidc behind the kill switch with a body bound derived from days since the record began, registry entry nsidc-sea-ice-index-shape, noaadata.apps.nsidc.org added to the existing Climate series row in SECURITY.md and the existing climate consent-popup lane (no new lane, no new locale key). Built on hand-made fixtures: the sandbox cannot reach the host, so the file shape is documented, not verified live. Not yet shipped: store wiring, the Statistics surface, the monthly files.
